messages:
ashley: FYI CVE-2026-9999 in libarchive (tar/zip extraction). PoC shows crafted archives can trigger remote code execution when unpacked by our artifact pipeline. Need prioritization: hosted ingestion + Private artifact uploads affected. Thoughts on SLA impact and rollout window?

mike: Confirmed first pass. It's transitive via our model-artifact unpacker in runtime-image v2.1. PoC requires uploading an archive to the model artifacts endpoint (no auth bypass) but exploit is possible if attacker has upload permission.

sanjay: Runtime team: upstream patch is merged. We'll need to rebuild runtime-image, update unpacker binary, and push new images. Rough ETA: 48h for full rebuild + tests if not prioritized.

eva: Product/sec: surface area: hosted API customers that never upload artifacts are unaffected. Enterprise + Private customers who upload models or use self-hosted ingestion are at risk. Need comms for enterprise/managed customers.

ashley: Proposed plan: 1) Hotfix hosted ingestion workers to use patched unpack path within 24h (quarantine uploads to a blocked queue). 2) Canary new runtime-image in us-west for 2h then global if clean. 3) Backport to Dedicated & Private in next weekly maintenance window. Is this realistic?

mike: Hotfix doable. We can flip ingestion workers to a quarantined unpacker (no execute, strict chroot) in ~4h and then switch to patched image. No token-level outage but uploads may be delayed. Will need ops support for quick rollback.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-4321 created: "libarchive CVE - artifact unpacker hotfix". Assigned to @mike, @sanjay.

sanjay: Canary plan: push image with patched libarchive, run sanity harness (model load/unpack against corpus) for 2h in us-west-2, monitor OOMs and latency. Rollout criteria: zero unpack failures and <2% unpack latency regression. Rollback if regressions or new errors.

eva: Comms: draft notice for enterprise customers: describe impact, mitigation (disable uploads or use signed artifacts), ETA for patched image, and offer private patching schedule. Also include recommended temporary mitigation: enable artifact-scanning and restrict upload roles.

ashley: SLA impact: hosted API availability unaffected for inference traffic, but artifact ingestion SLA may see degraded ingestion times for 24h. Need to log this as a possible SLA blip and surface to CS for customers on SLO-sensitive tiers.

mike: Ops notes: we can route uploads to a quarantine queue (no unpack) with a 6hr delay + customer-facing message. That keeps inference paths healthy.

ashley: Decision summary: mark CVE as high-priority. Action items: hotfix hosted ingestion within 24h (mike), canary + full rollout for runtime-image (sanjay), comms + enterprise notices (eva), file incident postmortem after patch (ashley).

sec-bot: Reminder: add CVE and affected versions to vulnerability registry and schedule verification scan after rollout.

eva: I'll draft comms and share in #product-security in 30m.

ashley: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after canary. :thumbsup:
